turns.content: v-FLIP contains two death-effector domains and binds DED-containing adaptors such as FADD at the death-inducing signaling complex. Summarize what those facts imply about its localization and possible interaction partners before inferring a phenotype.

FADD normally recruits the DED-containing initiator procaspase-8 to the DISC, where productive clustering enables its activation. Given that v-FLIP is catalytically inactive, explain why its occupation of the same DED interactions matters.
From that competition at the DISC, infer what happens to productive procaspase-8 recruitment and activation.
The DISC forms downstream of cell-surface death receptors. Use the local caspase-8 effect to identify the affected apoptosis pathway and predict the host-cell phenotype.
Distinguish this direct DISC effect from the mitochondrial intrinsic pathway. Does the stated mechanism justify any direct conclusion about intrinsic-pathway regulation?
Give the final effect of v-FLIP expression on host-cell apoptosis, naming the pathway and the DISC-level molecular mechanism.
